commandAudit.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files clang/lib/Driver clang/test/Driver | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- Driver.cpp size/anchors ---\\n' && wc -l clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp && rg -n \"BuildCompilation|Parse|ToolChain|ToolChains|getToolChain|set|ArgList|DerivedArgList|Compilation\" clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/include/clang/Driver/Driver.h | sed -n '620,810p' && nl -ba clang/include/clang/Driver/ToolChain.h | sed -n '70,235p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChain.cpp | sed -n '30,205p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in clang/test/Driver/driver-only.c clang/test/Driver/unknown-arg.c clang/test/Driver/target.c clang/test/Driver/target-override.c clang/test/Driver/biarch.c clang/test/Driver/sysroot.c clang/test/Driver/sysroot-flags.c clang/test/Driver/config-file.c clang/test/Driver/config-file3.c clang/test/Driver/config-file4.c clang/test/Driver/cl-options.c clang/test/Driver/cl-x86-flags.c clang/test/Driver/cl-cc-flags.c; do echo "--- $f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'1,220p'; done"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp | sed -n '7395,7520p' && nl -ba clang/include/clang/Driver/Driver.h | sed -n '90,145p;430,510p;820,845p' && rg -n \"getTargetAndModeFromProgramName\" clang/lib/Driver clang/include/clang/Driver | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Gnu.cpp | sed -n '3030,3125p;3470,3535p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Linux.cpp | sed -n '205,325p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Darwin.cpp | sed -n '980,1040p;1310,1365p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/MSVC.cpp | sed -n '500,590p;1110,1165p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/MinGW.cpp | sed -n '500,575p;600,670p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/BareMetal.cpp | sed -n '205,285p;285,335p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/test/Driver/parse-progname.c | sed -n '1,110p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/config-file3.c | sed -n '95,190p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/cl-options.c | sed -n '1,45p;220,245p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/dxc_debug.hlsl | sed -n '1,35p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -l -F 'Target:' clang/test/Driver | sed -n '1,120p' && rg -l -F '\"-triple\"' clang/test/Driver | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -l -F 'Configuration file:' clang/test/Driver | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/test/Driver/default-toolchain.c | sed -n '1,220p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/program-path-priority.c | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/linux-ld.c | sed -n '1,160p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/cross-linux.c | sed -n '1,140p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"getArgsForToolChain|TranslateArgs|TranslateOpenMPTargetArgs\" clang/lib/Driver/Compilation.cpp clang/include/clang/Driver/Compilation.h clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/Compilation.cpp | sed -n '60,155p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Cuda.cpp | sed -n '730,805p;870,925p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/AMDGPU.cpp | sed -n '665,730p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/HLSL.cpp | sed -n '385,445p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/SPIRV.cpp | sed -n '185,225p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba clang/test/Driver/openmp-offload.c | sed -n '1,150p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/cuda-options.cu | sed -n '1,90p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/amdgpu-toolchain.c | sed -n '1,100p' && nl -ba clang/test/Driver/dxc_spirv.hlsl | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ClangNameParts|TargetPrefix|TargetIsValid|DriverMode\" clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp clang/include/clang/Driver/Driver.h | sed -n '1,200p' && nl -ba clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp | sed -n '1870,1935p'"
